records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.model_share#1
records.source: WHY THERE IS NO BUILT-IN TOKEN. Uploading to one account from every user's machine would mean shipping a write token inside spaCR. A write token is not an upload permit: it can also rewrite and DELETE every model in that account, and anyone who installs spaCR can read it out of the package. So the upload uses the token belonging to whoever is running it:
records.context: Why there is no built-in token. Uploading to one account from every user's machine would mean shipping a write token inside spaCR. A write token is not an upload permit: it can also rewrite and DELETE every model in that account, and anyone who installs spaCR can read it out of the package. So the upload uses the token belonging to whoever is executing it:
records.translation: POR QUÉ NO HAY UN TOKEN INTEGRADO. Subir a una cuenta desde la máquina de cada usuario supondría distribuir un token de escritura dentro de spaCR. Un token de escritura no es un permiso de subida: también puede reescribir y ELIMINAR todos los modelos de esa cuenta, y cualquiera que instale spaCR puede extraerlo del paquete. Así que la subida usa el token de quien la ejecuta:
records.review_basis: MT draft edited in AI review

records.source: It publishes to :data:`SHARE_REPO` when that token may write there -- the owner can grant that per person in the repository's settings -- and otherwise to the uploader's own namespace, which always works and is never destructive to somebody else. Either way the model card carries the same table, so a shared model is readable in the same terms as a bundled one.
records.context: It publishes to :data:`SHARE_REPO` when that token may write there -- the owner can grant that per person in the repository's settings -- and otherwise to the uploader's own namespace, which always works and is never destructive to somebody else. Either way the model card carries the same table, so a shared model is readable in the same terms as a bundled one.
records.translation: Publica en :data:`SHARE_REPO` cuando ese token puede escribir allí -- el propietario puede concederlo persona a persona en los ajustes del repositorio -- y, si no, en el espacio de nombres propio de quien sube, lo que siempre funciona y nunca es destructivo para nadie más. En ambos casos la tarjeta del modelo lleva la misma tabla, de modo que un modelo compartido se lee en los mismos términos que uno incluido.

records.translation: Sin comprimir a propósito: los TIFFs de microscopía ya se comprimen mal y pasar por gzip decenas de gigabytes cuesta mucho más tiempo del que ahorra en bytes. Lanza una excepción si el resultado fuera mayor de lo que acepta el endpoint, ANTES de intentar la subida, para que un usuario no espere a que termine una transferencia que nunca iba a aceptarse.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.model_zoo_picker#4
records.source: WHY THE LIST HAS FIVE HEADINGS RATHER THAN A BOOLEAN. It used to be one list with "show unvetted community uploads" beside it -- a control that could fold away exactly one of the catalogue's five origins. With ten models trained here, four stock Cellpose-SAM backbones, bioimage.io's collection, the Cellpose 3 backend's own four and a shared catalogue, a user who wanted the ten and not the rest had no way to say so. :class:`SourceStrip` is the five origins as five clickable names, each one blue when its rows are on screen and muted when they are folded away, remembered between openings. The warning the boolean carried is unchanged and still arrives before the first unvetted row does -- see :meth:`ModelZooPicker._may_show_source`.
records.context: Why the list has five headings rather than a boolean. It used to be one list with "show unvetted community uploads" beside it -- a control that could fold away exactly one of the catalogue's five origins. With ten models trained here, four stock Cellpose-SAM backbones, bioimage.io's collection, the Cellpose 3 backend's own four and a shared catalogue, a user who wanted the ten and not the rest had no way to say so. :class:`SourceStrip` is the five origins as five clickable names, each one blue when its rows are on application view and muted when they are folded away, remembered between openings. The warning the boolean carried is unchanged and still arrives before the first unvetted row does -- see :meth:`ModelZooPicker._may_show_source`.
records.translation: POR QUÉ LA LISTA TIENE CINCO ENCABEZADOS EN LUGAR DE UN BOOLEANO. Antes era una sola lista con "show unvetted community uploads" al lado -- un control que podía plegar exactamente uno de los cinco orígenes del catálogo. Con diez modelos entrenados aquí, cuatro redes base estándar de Cellpose-SAM, la colección de bioimage.io, los cuatro propios del motor Cellpose 3 y un catálogo compartido, un usuario que quisiera los diez y no el resto no tenía forma de decirlo. :class:`SourceStrip` son los cinco orígenes como cinco nombres en los que se puede hacer clic, cada uno en azul cuando sus filas están en pantalla y atenuado cuando están plegadas, recordados entre aperturas. La advertencia que llevaba el booleano no ha cambiado y sigue llegando antes que la primera fila sin revisar -- véase :meth:`ModelZooPicker._may_show_source`.
records.review_basis: MT draft edited in AI review

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.model_zoo_picker.remembered_sources#1
records.source: Through QSettings for the same reason the download folder is -- the headings a user folds away stay folded away tomorrow, not only for the rest of this dialog. Read here rather than held on the dialog so the Make Masks Mode box and the Model Zoo page answer from the same preference without owning a copy of it.
records.context: Through QSettings for the same reason the download folder is -- the headings a user folds away stay folded away tomorrow, not only for the rest of this dialog. records.translation: Mediante QSettings, por el mismo motivo que la carpeta de descargas -- los encabezados que un usuario pliega siguen plegados mañana, no solo durante el resto de este diálogo. Se lee aquí en lugar de guardarse en el diálogo para que el cuadro Mode de Make Masks y la página Model Zoo respondan a partir de la misma preferencia sin tener cada uno una copia.
